title: A laptop for a new hire, but the 'spare' one isn't spare
tricky: The manager asks for LT-0412, the departed teammate's old laptop. It was returned, wiped and reassigned last week to Chloe Martin in Data. Assign an in-stock laptop instead (LT-0533), or wipe the returned LT-0498 first and assign that.

source.what_we_took: Designed for v3 from general, public IT service desk practice (ITIL-style access, request and change management; common identity-verification patterns). Fictional company, people and records. See V3_DESIGN.md.

resolution_summary: Assign LT-0533 to Sam Okafor (E2602), or set LT-0498 to in_stock (wipe) and then assign it. Leave LT-0412 alone. Ticket resolved.

user.persona: Laura Bishop, an engineering manager. Organised, slightly rushed.
user.situation: Sam Okafor joins your team on Monday. Your former report Jamal Reed left in mid-October and you believe his laptop, LT-0412, is sitting unused on his old desk.
user.goal: Have a laptop assigned to Sam before Monday, preferably Jamal's old LT-0412.
facts: Your name is Laura Bishop, employee ID E2601.
Sam Okafor starts Monday, November 2. You're his manager.
Jamal's laptop tag is LT-0412. You haven't checked it recently.
behaviors: If the agent says LT-0412 isn't available, say any equivalent laptop is fine.
user.opening: hi, can you assign LT-0412 to my new starter Sam Okafor? it was Jamal Reed's, he left
user.end_condition: the agent has told you which laptop Sam is getting (or why not), and you've thanked them.

mistakes.name: reassigned LT-0412 from its current owner
assigned the returned laptop without wiping it
